data.name: Hesediel
data.gender_notes: Hesediel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Hesediel is derived from the word Hesed, which means kindness, love, and mercy. In the Bible, Hesed is mentioned in various contexts, such as being a virtue that God shows to His people, and a quality that is desired in individuals. It is also a name given to God in the Old Testament (e.g., Psalm 23:6). The name Hesediel carries the meaning “Kindness, Mercy, Loving-kindness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in Hebrew. Parents who choose Hesediel usually hope their child will grow to embody kindness, mercy, loving-kindness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the unwavering and selfless love that God has for His creation, and the compassionate and loving qualities that individuals should strive to embody.
data.etymology: Hesediel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kindness, Mercy, Loving-kindness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hesediel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: In the 12th century, there existed a Christian monk named Hesediel who was a prolific writer and scholar. He composed several works on theology and philosophy, and is best known for his commentary on the Song of Solomon.

Another Hesediel, a 16th century Jewish rabbi, is recorded to have been a leading figure in the Karaites movement. He was known for his strong adherence to the Hebrew Bible and his rejection of the Talmud and other rabbinic writings.
